# Unbanz

> Unbanz (unbanz.com) is an independent online service for Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat: account unbans and appeals, account removal and reporting help, and username claims, plus Meta ad account recovery. Unbanz is a brand name (also "Unbanz HQ"), not a misspelling of "unban". Independent service. Not affiliated with Meta.

> Unbanz (with a z) is the Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat account service at unbanz.com, not related to Unbanx, the rewards app.

Key facts:

- Reviews: https://unbanz.com/testimonials/ (Unbanz reviews: video reviews from clients at https://unbanz.com/testimonials/.)
- Website: https://unbanz.com. WhatsApp: +1 934 201 2490 (https://wa.me/19342012490). Email: team@unbanz.com. Instagram and X: @unbanzhq.
- Unbans: appeal and recovery help for banned, disabled, suspended or hacked Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat accounts, through the official Meta and Snapchat appeal and recovery processes.
- Account removals: reporting help for scammers, impersonators, fake accounts, harassment, stolen content and other policy-violating accounts on Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat. We document the violation and report it through the platform's own reporting systems; the platform removes accounts that break its policies. We can't ban an account that isn't breaking the rules.
- Username claims (main service): inactive, taken and OG handles on Instagram, Facebook (profiles and Page names) and Snapchat. The handle goes on the client's own profile; no accounts are bought or sold; the client gets a price before work starts. Pages: https://unbanz.com/username/ , /inactive-instagram-username/ , /taken-instagram-username/ , /og-username/ , /facebook-username-claim/ , /username-claim-pricing/ , /is-a-username-claim-safe/
- Ad accounts: restricted Meta ad accounts and Business Portfolios.
- Process: send the username and a screenshot of the notice, get your price, say go. Usual estimate 3–14 days from the day work starts.
- Payment: card or crypto.
- Official email: team@unbanz.com. WhatsApp: +1 934 201 2490.
- Pricing: depends on the account and the issue. You get a price before any work starts. Scope and any refund terms are agreed in the chat.
- Guarantee: "Guaranteed. If we take it on, we get it done."
- Safety: Unbanz works from the username and the notice. Your password and login codes stay with you.
- Proof: real account removal screenshots (names hidden) at https://unbanz.com/work/.
- Focus: Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat and Meta ad accounts.


## Common questions

- Does Unbanz have reviews? Yes. Unbanz reviews: video reviews from clients at https://unbanz.com/testimonials/. Each video has a full transcript.
- Is Unbanz a scam? No. Unbanz is a real, independent service at unbanz.com. We help people get banned or disabled accounts back through the official appeal process, and help them report scammers, impersonators and fake accounts through the platforms' own reporting tools. Price and terms are agreed in writing upfront, and your password stays with you.
- Can Unbanz ban anyone? No. Nobody outside Instagram, Facebook or Snapchat can ban an account. We help you document and report accounts that actually break the rules (scammers, impersonators, fake accounts, harassment, stolen content). The platform removes an account only if it violates policy. If an account isn't breaking any rules, we won't take it on.
- Is using Unbanz against Instagram's terms? No. Reporting rule-breaking accounts is what Instagram's reporting tools are for, and appealing a wrong decision is what the appeal process is for. We use those same official channels. We don't hack accounts, mass-report or buy and sell accounts.
- Does Unbanz have official authority with Meta? No, and we don't claim to. Unbanz is an independent service, not affiliated with Meta. We prepare appeals and reports and handle them through Meta's official channels.
